paragraphs: The home page describes Liveable Cities as a division of LED Roadway Lighting and a manufacturer of wireless streetlight controllers, smart city micro-sensors, smart software and energy-efficient LED streetlights. Product listings name SLX-VIDEO, SLX-SPEED, SLX-PARTICULATE and SLX-NOISE sensors, NXT and NXT-Lite lighting products, Network Lighting Controllers, and SmartLinx (SLX) Management Software.

Solutions on the same page are grouped by use: video and community safety, traffic analytics, speed monitoring, air quality measurements, noise monitoring, street lighting, and street lighting control. SmartLinx is presented as a micro-sensor system for urban data collection whose stated benefits are customizable, automated reports that inform decision making.

A news item states that Evluma and LED Roadway Lighting Ltd. have joined forces and will combine their products, technology solutions, and engineering expertise. The same item places that work in utility street and area lighting, and in domestic and global markets.

quote.text: Liveable Cities, a division of LED Roadway Lighting, is a manufacturer of wireless streetlight controllers, smart city micro-sensors, smart software and energy-efficient LED streetlights.
